Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This publication describes the development and validation of a new computational method (Subset-Neighbor Search, SNS) for False Discovery Rate (FDR) control in proteomics database searches. While the authors use several datasets (UPS1/Yeast, Ricin, Human, ISB18) to test the algorithm, these are used as benchmarks for statistical performance (power and FDR control) rather than as biological perturbations or differential experiments. The study is a method-development paper focused on bioinformatics/algorithm validation, not a perturbation proteomics study.
